        next_index = p[index - 1]
        while next_index != index:
            visited[next_index] = True
            cycle.append(next_index)
            next_index = p[next_index - 1]

            for j in range(half_length):
                result[cycle[j]] = cycle[half_length + j]
                result[cycle[half_length + j]] = cycle[j]
